Unchanged from P2: same die and DEVICE_ID as the fixed input; fails rule 4 at JLCPCB (1, presale -115) but Digi-Key stock 5024 clears the gate as a personal-library purchase route (rule 6, once bought in and its quantity stated).
Unchanged from P2: widest accuracy-share margin (0.50 A of 1.5 A at 150 A), four-terminal Kelvin, largest second-vendor stock (Digi-Key 11190).
Unchanged from P2: passes with a second vendor; below the BVR because its TCR is stated only 20-60 degC and the terminal temperature at 150 A is not independently confirmed.

Best accuracy at the 100 degC trip point (+/-0.5 degC max, -20 to 100 degC) with a second vendor (Digi-Key 21589), and its 4 addresses (0x18-0x1F) sit outside the 0x40-0x4F block IOBoard.md:462-464 reserves for the port and motor monitors. Still first after adding STTS22H and ADT7410: both have worse accuracy at 100 degC (STTS22H +/-1.0 degC, ADT7410 +/-0.5 degC only tying, not beating, it) and MCP9808's 4-week Digi-Key lead time and largest stock margin are unmatched.

New candidate from P3 (missed: STMicroelectronics was not searched). Passes every requirement value; +/-1.0 degC max at the 100 degC trip point (the -40 to 125 degC row of Table 3; the tighter +/-0.5 degC band only covers -10 to 60 degC). Its 4 addresses (0x38, 0x3C, 0x3E, 0x3F) sit outside the 0x40-0x4F monitor block, the same address advantage that puts MCP9808 ahead of TMP116 in P2's own ranking; on that basis it outranks the in-block TMP116, ADT7410 and TMP112 despite their tighter accuracy. Second-vendor stock is adequate (Digi-Key 752, JLCPCB 550) but its 24-week Digi-Key lead time and worse accuracy keep it below MCP9808.

Unchanged from P2: +/-0.25 degC, the best accuracy figure of any candidate, stock at both vendors; ranks below the two address-outside parts because its 4 addresses (0x48-0x4B) sit inside the 0x40-0x4F monitor block.

P3 correctly showed the prior drop reason for this part did not hold: its own datasheet gives +/-0.5 degC max from -40 to 105 degC at VDD 2.7-3.6 V (covering the 100 degC trip point directly), not the +/-2 degC that actually describes the LM75BD it was grouped with, and the '11-bit, 330 at JLCPCB' facts belong to the PCT2075, not this part. It qualifies: JLCPCB C660048 stock 1009/presale 989 clears the gate, Digi-Key stock 847 gives a second vendor. Ranked behind TMP116 (better accuracy, same in-block address class) and above TMP112 (worse accuracy, 1.0 degC) per the accuracy-tier ordering P2 used between those two; its own address block (0x48-0x4B, same as TMP116) is inside the monitor block, and it is the highest-priced part on the list (4.7563 at the 1 break) with the smallest Digi-Key stock of the group.

Unchanged from P2, now last of five: +/-1 degC, largest stock at both vendors and lowest price; below the +/-0.5 degC and +/-0.25 degC parts on accuracy, and its address (0x48-0x4B) is inside the monitor block like ADT7410's, but its accuracy margin at the 100 degC trip point ties ADT7410's tier only nominally (1.0 vs 0.5 degC) so it stays behind it.
